evidence.title: Slides. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Slides (How to AI)
summary: Guide comparing three ways to generate slide decks with AI: Claude, Gamma, and Claude plus Gamma.
description: A How to AI newsletter guide on making presentations with AI. It walks through three methods: prompting Claude Cowork to create a .pptx, generating polished decks in Gamma, and a combined research, brief, generate and edit workflow. A team section shows how to turn brand assets into a Gamma theme and a markdown brand-rules file.
contains: 3 AI slide methods: Claude, Gamma, Claude + Gamma
research to brief to generate to edit workflow
team section on brand themes and prompt files
